name: Men's Aviator Shirt Uniform blue tie (overlay, registered to garment-aviator-shirt-male; also the group "tie" of the sheet)
size_basis: The tie of the sheet's group "tie" as an overlay: the Class A construction (base-art/tie.js: knot apex at the front of the collar, knot shoulder on the leaves' leading edge, neck, blade, tip) at the Class A coat's proportions (knot 1.8 in wide, blade 3 in at its widest), 21.9 in from knot apex to tip, the tip 80 % of the way down the belt buckle so it covers part of it and does not extend below it (4.2.5.1.4). No dimension in the regulation.
landmarks_note: rects are {x,y,w,h} in user units (0.01 in)
documented: blue tie (blue polyester or silk, herringbone twill); the CAP regimental tie is not authorized with the aviator shirt uniform; tip covers part of the buckle but not below it (CAPR 39-1 4.2.5.1.4)
assumed: tie colour (the Class A tie, tie.js)
